big_case.notes: First Supreme Court construction of RLUIPA's land-use substantial-burden provision (grant limited to QP1), a question circuits have split on for two decades, with a 20-state coalition and 16 cert-stage amici; the holding will govern church-zoning litigation nationwide. The facts (a small grotto on a church parcel, private neighbors as adverse parties) are modest and the case is statutory rather than constitutional, so it sits above the median merits case but below the Term's headline matters. The predictors' big_case_score values sit in the staged prediction.json files, so this read could not be formed strictly before seeing them; it rests on the record and the grant, not on those numbers.
